preset.description:
Resources preset for the cluster.

Supported values:
- nano
- micro
- small
- medium
- large
- xlarge
- 2xlarge

replicas.description:
Number of replicas.
1 = standalone mode (storage-level replication)
2-8 = cluster mode (application-level replication)
Mode cannot be changed after creation.

authEnabled.description: Enable Redis authentication. When enabled, a password is generated and returned on creation.
